STUNNING Furnished Two Bedroom, 2 Bathroom TOWNHOUSE in Point Grey!

Price: $7,750 per month on one year lease
Available: October 1st
Listing Brokerage: REMAX City Realty
Sq Ft.: 1,800
Bedrooms: 2 + Sofabed in Den/Loft
Bathrooms:2
Utilities Included: Hot Water and Natural Gas
Parking: Available

Tenancy Length: Negotiable

Amenities: Private Yard
Included Items:: Gourmet Chef's Kitchen w/ Soft-Close Custom Cabinetry, Stainless appliances, dishwasher, gas fireplace, washer and dryer, Central vacuum, black-out blinds in bedrooms. Units features lots of natural light, hardwood floors, recently painted and fully renovated. Designer furniture and plenty of storage throughout!
Description: The townhome that you have been waiting for! This 1,800 sqft 2 bedroom + den home features a modern gourmet kitchen and large bedrooms. Master bedroom has own ensuite with soaker tub! A generous main floor features excellent living space, fireplace, stunning water views and more! One of Vancouver's premier neighbourhoods, this property has superb access to transit, shopping, parks, the beach, excellent schools and more. Move-in Ready! Just bring your suitcase.
Contact: 672-514-8989 to set a viewing today! (Note number is new local Vancouver area code!)

**** Professionally managed and marketed by REMAX City Realty. There are no additional fees or charges to rent an apartment through Proximity Real Estate, and there is no fee to view, apply for or rent any of our suites. We are licensed with the Real Estate Council of British Columbia and simply act as the landlord/marketer for the owner.****
